balls.text: goes full outside leg stump, 132kph and cramping Russell for room. Punched down to long-on, Russell finishes his blitz with a single. But he's given KKR a competitive total at halfway
full and wide, chipped down to long-off by Starc
well bowled, leg-stump yorker and he has to settle for a swipe to long-off
shortish and helped away into the leg side
low full toss, swatted behind point, Starc gets up and running in purple with a boundary
top-edged in the slog, taken at long-on! Rinku knows he has to go (or get Russell on strike). He opts for the former and holes out to Markram a few yards in off the rope
short and smashed! Jumps into a flat-batted mow through cover and that's the KKR 200 up! Dre Russ punches the back of his bat, he is cooking in the Garden tonight
tonked over cover, six more! Goes for the wide yorker by misses his length but a few feet. Russell holds the pose on one knee as he slaughters another one into the boards
low full toss, heaved away to wide long-off, they'll charge back for two
Russell steps away, Bhuvi goes for the wide line... too wide
short ball, swatted off the nose! Dre Russ brings up fifty with his sixth six. Vintage stuff from the veteran West Indies allrounder. Bit top-edgey but it flies all the way over fine leg
gets the yorker to land, 136kph angling across. Rinku digs it out for one
goes wide blockhole, Russell swings himself into an extravagant drive. Just one to the cover sweeper
low full toss, helped away through midwicket! Looked to have got away with it but the strength of the man gets it to the rope between two boundary riders
Rinku finishes with four more down the ground! In the slot again and lofted back towards long-off
short and sliding down leg as Rinku bails out
Natarjan digs the ball into the pitch and gets Russell off strike
belted into the crowd! Russell is a mood tonight. Half-volley on the pads and he doesn't miss out
full down the leg side, another wide from Natarajan
slower-ball bouncer, gets too bouncy as Russell leans back and attempts to ramp
back of a length, fifth stump and guided calmly to short third by Rinku
short of a length and Russell mistimes an attempted muscle down the ground. Single to long-off
speared through backward point, Rinku gets in on the fun. Low full toss at 141kph and he opens the face to pick up four
full on the pads, Rinku picks up two into the gap at deep square leg
pitched up, 135kph and this is walloped down to long-off for one. Bhuvi will take that
short and smeared through square leg, 128kph length delivery and slugged for four as he backs away
Russell in a rush, battered over midwicket! Back of a length and hauled high into the crowd one again. Just Dre Russ things
back of a length on fourth stump, Rinku runs it behind point

slogged down the ground, taken! Markram is claiming the catch running in from long-off. What does the smart replay say? Very grainy image for Bruce Oxenford to work with, but he reckons there was ball on the ground before the fingers got around it. Cheers from the home crowd, Russell will continue
Dre Russssssssss! Markande is getting a mauling. Tossed up wide of off and he launches on to the front foot to pump him over long-on
connects again! Another one sails over deep midwicket! Plants the front foot and swings with a vengeance across the line, goes fully 102 metres!
pushed through on the stumps, defended
tossed up towards the tramlines, called wide but SRH review it. And the replay shows it was inside the tramlines, so the call is overturned
boom! Slog-swept into the crowd! Vintage Dre Russ, keeps his head down and eyes on the ball, before clonking it over deep midwicket. 91-metre six
full, straight, 141kph and carved out to deep point
short but with pace off, 115kph and spinning through past Russell's belligerent swipe across the line
round the wicket, back of a length outside off and jabbed down to deep third
full length, 143kph, heaved away through square leg for one
nasty delivery, 139kph and rising sharply off a length. Russell ducks and loses sight of it, splicing the ball into the off side as he reaches out in front
short of a length, steered for one
tossed up and he shows it a diligent straight bat in defence

Salt swings to leg, but holes out to Jansen in the deep! Salt has shaken his last after giving the KKR fans a taste. Stepped away as Markande pushed one down the leg side, didn't quite get hold of his shot - but it still needed good work from Jansen running around to his right and diving full length for the catch
very full and loopy wide of off, 80kph and driven down to long-off
dragged down and swung away leg side
hammered through the covers, fifty for Salt! Steps away and clobbers a legbreak through the infield. Salute to the home fans, a fine start for the England man on KKR debut
looped up and driven, the bowler swoops to his left to collect
full on leg stump, 141kph and flicked wide of fine leg for a couple
back of a length into the body and Rinku nudges it to the infielder
short ball swivelled away on the pull through square leg
short of a length, 140kph into the body. Rinku rocks back and angles the ball to deep third
lofted over mid-off, four first ball! Steps into a full delivery from Cummins and just dismisses it from his sight

chipped to cover, Cummins strikes! Hit high on the bat as he looked to drive on the up, well held by Markande diving across to his right. Ramandeep won't be taking this deep. The KKR recovery takes a hit
smeared through the off side, Salt picks up four more. Steps away to a flat delivery wide of off and beats extra cover inside the ring with a meaty swipe
worked for a single into the leg side, bringing up the 50 stand
clipped down the ground
floated up and Salt picks out cover on the drive
quicker and straighter, nurdled to leg for one
tossed up wide of the stumps, 87kph and Ramandeep toe-ends an attempted slog down the ground
launched over cover, six more! Ramandeep is on one here. Makes some room and lofts this, easy as you like, into the boundary boards
back of a length outside off, Salt slaps a cut in front of square and pushes hard for two
dug in and swatted away through backward square leg for one more
short and swung high over the fence! Just helped on its way towards fine leg for his third six of the night
back of a length, bounces through past the top edge as Ramandeep hangs the bat out
short and angling across, 134kph and Salt pulls. Just one out to deep midwicket
length ball, crunched through cover! Lovely timing from Salt, driving on the up. Picks up his first four of the night
pushed through, 93kph on off stump. Prodded back to the bowler
better length, beats the bat as he goes back looking to defend
boshed into the crowd! Ramandeep rams this deep over long-on, 90 metres off the bat. Rocks back and dispatches the drag-down from Markande
googly, on a length and worked with the turn. Into the gap and Ramandeep runs hard for two
similar line, hacked in front of square
Tossed up wide of off and Salt is able to cut, gets it away behind point for a couple thanks to a Markram misfield
short and hooked flat! No doubt about the connection from Ramandeep on this one as he nails Cummins' shoulder-high bouncer into the advertising boards
heaved away off the leg side, one bounce out to deep square
fullish on the stumps, 144kph, pushed back down to long-on
fired full and straight, clipped firmly to midwicket
short and deflected up and over, Ramandeep looking to pull and getting some top edge - actually may have been off the helmet, too - for a boundary fine
full on the pads, flicked away to fine leg
93kph wrong'un outside off, Salt rocks back and thrashes the ball to the cover sweeper for one
chopped into the covers
pushed through outside off, chopped towards point. Good bit of fielding but Salt looked to be home as Klaassen broke the bails

googly, Rana reverses... straight to backward point! Simple head-height catch for Tripathi and Rana can only offer a rueful smile as he walks off. Funky stuff fails to land, Markande strikes with his third ball. KKR slip deeper into the hole
looped up, 89kph on off stump and punched out to the cover sweeper
over the wicket, dragged down to begin with as Rana, batting in a cap, walks at him. Flicked off the pads for one
full length, fourth stump and swiped to the man in the covers
into the pitch again, Salt heaves a couple more out towards cow corner, long-on running around
dropped! Short and slapped, just beyond Samad in the covers! He was running back towards the edge of the ring and got one hand to it. Fingertips, but you've seen them taken
full, angling across, 135kph. Salt throws the plumbing and thick-edges one to deep third
full, straight and punched through mid-off, whose diving attempt is unsuccessful. Long-on comes around
length ball, steepling bounce in the channel. Salt is beaten attempting to open the face for one
back of a length, over the top of off, tucked to midwicket - and that is Sunrisers' powerplay, three consecutive sixes from Phil Salt aside
length ball, 130kph in the channel. Rana tries to run it fine but doesn't connect
round the wicket, back of a length and Salt chops a thick inside edge towards short fine
fullish, hint of swing back into the right-hander. Driven watchfully to mid-off
full and straight, Rana is across his stumps and flicks one out to deep backward square leg
full on off stump and Salt punches a single through point
short ball down leg, trampoline bounce and called wide on height
into the pitch again, 142kph and pulled without much timing. Mid-on has to make ground to their left and they get back for two
fired across the bows, 142kph and toe-ended towards slip on the bounce
short and hoicked away! Swivels on the pull and dispatches his first runs through backward square leg
angled across, 136kph in the channel. Rana picks out cover
140kph, pitched up outside off and this is driven square, just a single to the point sweeper
charges in and hits a hard length, Salt defends coming across on off
shuffles across and taps the ball away

chipped to mid-off! Superb take above his head by Cummins, and SRH have taken a third wicket inside the powerplay. Full from Natarajan and Shreyas was looking to loft it over the off side, almost cleared the man on the edge of the ring... but his opposite number is a tall bloke and reels in the catch. First down payment on that INR 20.5 crore fee from Cummins
length ball angling across, 133kph and dabbed to point for a quick single

larruped... straight to cover! Bit of a slot ball, really, and Iyer was looking to cash in with a hard-handed drive. But he couldn't have picked out the fielder better, Jansen staying low to clutch the ball to his chest. Second wicket of the evening for SRH
steps down and flicks four to leg, Iyer on the move and using the pace to get it past the man in the ring at short fine
shortish from over the wicket, smacked back with a cross bat. Looks momentarily like another boundary for Salt, but Markram flies to his left to cut it off
touch too straight this time, shovelled off the pads for two
jaffa from Bhuvi, 132kph and nipping away from a length. Iyer walks into it and is beaten comprehensively trying to work to leg
length ball, dabbed down into the covers for one
does him again, tighter line this time and again past the shoulder of the bat with Salt prodding uncertainly
excellent line, climbs through on fifth stump as Salt gets square up and beaten
nudged off the pads for his first run

banged into the deck, Salt fends it away to backward point... and Narine has run himself out looking for one! Direct hit from Shahbaz Ahmed and he's nowhere in the frame! Salt had no intention of running there but Narine got about halfway down before noticing. Barely bothered to try and make his ground, with Jansen lurking to complete the run-out if needed
SALT AND PEPPERED! Steps into a length ball and smooshes it way back over extra cover! Third six in a row, this one 84m. Imperious from the KKR new boy
clobbered! Sits back and slaps six more square! Short and sweetly struck. Salt happily rides the bounce all the way over point again
honked off a length, all the way over point! Salt frees the arms and piles into some width, carved away for the first six of the night. Only 72 metres but lands in the crowd
flung full and wide, nibbling away as Salt swings and misses. Umpire signals wide
into the body, good bounce and Salt deflects it towards short fine leg. Was there some glove? Only a brief appeal, think it came off the thigh pad
over the wicket, pitched up at 130kph outside off. Narine hacks agriculturally towards mid-on for another single
nips back, beats the edge! Salt was looking to shuffle down, couldn't get on top of the bounce as it slid through past the bat
pitched up in the channel, 135kph and Salt drives, plinked to the man in the covers
goes full again, some shape into the pads as Narine steps away and swipes one fine of mid-on
full and swinging in on off stump, 137kph. Jammed down behind square
hint of inswing, on a good length and Narine tries to bully it up and over. Doesn't connect, bobbles to midwicket
stays over the wicket, short of a length down the leg side
shortish and wide of off stump, Salt thrashes a thick outside edge down to deep third

superb final over! KKR can now breathe. He bowls another slower ball, and foxes Cummins too. On a length in the channel outside off, and there is some extra bounce too, as Cummins swings his bat and is beaten. KKR win by 4 runs

great catch by Suyash! Someone listen to the deafening roar at Eden. Suyash, placed at short third, had to half-turn around while moving back and keeping his eyes on the ball. It arrived on him over his right shoulder, and he tumbled to take it. Another slower ball from Harshit, as he rolls his fingers over it. Bowls on a hittable length, though, and just outside off. Klaasen has a go at it aiming for the leg side, but plays early and gets it off a top edge
change of pace on a length just outside off, and angling back in towards middle. Swished to deep midwicket on the bounce

finds long-on! The crowd at Eden suddenly wakes up from sleep. Shahbaz falls, leaving this on the knife's edge. Harshit went on the shorter side of a length, while angling it across. The ball arrived around middle and off, as Shahbaz shaped to launch it down the ground but mistimed the shot for a simple catch for Shreyas
slower ball, and quite full on sixth stump. He went swinging, but got a bottom edge on to his back leg. The ball trickled towards point
blasted over fine leg! This is incredible. He is repeating his heroics from the World Cup last year. Short of a length around off, and absolutely clubbed for a pull for six more

swiped over deep backward square leg! The local boy is following his partner in cracking sixes. It is a full toss arriving just outside off, with Shahbaz having got across already. The ball lands near his stomach, and he creams it way over the boundary
an inswinging yorker-length ball on off, and squeezed to long-on
over deep extra cover! This is terrific from Klaasen, who raises his fifty off 25 balls. Full ball and a bit wide of off, with Klaasen, who is deep in the crease, drilling it with a horizontal bat
Klaasened over deep midwicket! On the shorter side of a length, and angled in from around the wicket, as this pitches just outside off and finishes closer to off, with Klaasen pulling for six more
bowls a yorker which is pretty wide of off. Klaasen still went after it but missed, and it is called wide
ahh, the length was there to be smashed, but Klaasen missed! On a fullish length around off and angling away after pitching, as Klaasen had a go across the line but was beaten
just over deep midwicket! That came off the inside half of the bat, but who cares? A fullish delivery swinging in and finishing on leg, as Klaasen slogs across to bag another six!
bowls full and wide of off, as Shahbaz looks to slash after getting a bit across, but is beaten
this is a huge six! Goes a long way over long-on. Fullish ball and angling across to finish a bit wide of off, with Shahbaz collapsing his back knee to send it flying
yorker length, and quicker on off. Dragged to long-on with his front leg out of the way
flayed away over long-on! He gets a fullish ball arriving wide of off and turning away, and heaves across the line even as he has to reach out for it
on the bounce to long-on running forward and across to his right. Short and quick from Varun around middle and off, as Klaasen pulled off the higher side of the bat
rammed down the ground! This was full and just outside off, with a hint of turn away. But Klaasen read that, and crashed it towards the sightscreen
over short fine leg! Sharp short ball from Russell, as this arrives on middle stump. Shahbaz takes his eyes off and swivels to pull, getting it over the man at short fine leg

straight to deep midwicket! The fielder was placed right on the edge of the rope, and that arrived at a comfortable height, in front of his stomach. It was a full toss which was dipping just outside off, as Samad wasn't able to time his swing. He waited for a few seconds to confirm if it wasn't an above-waist no-ball or not, before heading back. But he's asked to wait, as the umpires take a look again. And replays confirm it arrived at him just below the waist, so it is not a no-ball
bottom edge goes to short fine. He goes slashing at this fullish ball which is a bit wide of off, but hardly times it
this is better, as Russell bowls even fuller, and just outside off. Jammed to long-on
this is launched back down the ground! It was almost a yorker length, though, and just outside off, with Samad deep in the crease to study these deliveries
hoicked over deep midwicket! Length delivery just outside off, as he clears his front leg to smash that hard and flat
fuller side of a length on middle, and swiped wide of long-on, as Starc hardly gives anything away
now bowls a yorker on the stumps, which Klaasen drags to deep midwicket
ahh, well bowled! Goes with a slower ball on a short of a length on middle and off, getting it to angle away and bounce nicely. Klaasen looked to ramp but missed
another length ball on middle, and this is pulled unconvincingly to deep square leg
on a length on middle and leg, and pushed back to the bowler's right. There seemed to be too much pace for the batter there
fuller side of a length on leg, and heaved to deep midwicket with his front leg out of the way
tossed up, and the length is very full and a bit wide of off. He looks to ram that, but is beaten by the length
looks to slash this length ball around sixth stump, but is beaten

belted over long-off! Shreyas seemed interested, but it was beyond him. Short in length again from Varun, and this one is again outside off. Again Klaasen waits for it, and slams it with a horizontal bat
this is full, and angling away to finish wide of off. Left alone, but not called wide
short of a length outside off, and pumped over the bowler's head! That was hit very forcefully, as he stood deep in the crease and swung his bat for six
on the bounce to long-off! Full and angling across towards off, as he lofted with little timing
yorker length on the sumps, and squeezed wide of long-on. But Russell moves and tumbles to his right to keep it to two
just short of Nitish at fine leg! He had to rush and dive forward, and the landed barely below his hands. Full and angling in at Samad, who slog swept off his pads
again goes flatter and quicker on a full length on off, while turning away a bit. Slashed to extra cover
full and dipping on leg, as it hits his front pad outside leg after he misses his flick
fuller and quicker, as this dips on leg. Pushed hurriedly towards deep point
uff, sharp turn from a length on off, and ending outside leg, as he looked to slash after making room, but missed

hit on the pad first ball, and there's a confident appeal for lbw which is turned down. They discuss... and review after a while. This ball was turning in, with Samad defending on off stump, but the ball finishing on middle and leg, and going between bat and pad. There is no inside edge there. Ahh, it is umpire's call on hitting the top of middle and leg as the ball pitched on a length on fifth stump, and turned back in sharply

taken at fine leg! Narine strikes after being economical all day. Tripathi keeps attempting the sweep, and finds the fielder on this occasion. His struggle ends at a run-a-ball 20. The ball was again full, as Tripathi went slogging across the line
on a length, and bouncing nicely while turning in too to finish on fifth stump. He looked to slash, but was beaten
on a full length, but heading down to finish outside leg. Clipped to long leg
this is full again, but wide outside off. Swept to deep square leg
full ball dipping just outside off. Driven to long-off
fuller side of a length on the stumps, and keeps a little low. Pushed wide of long-on
on a length on middle, and turning in. Hits his pad outside leg, as he looked to flick but missed

nabbed at deep midwicket! He had to take a few steps forward, and then bend to take it low. Rinku was the fielder there. Varun bowled full and on the stumps, as Markram went slog sweeping across the line, but ended up playing down the longer side of the ground. He departs, as SRH's required rate keeps rising
skips down, and punches this shortish ball around off to extra cover
slog sweeps this length delivery on middle and off to fine leg
on a length, and angled in, but pitches on off and turns away. Slapped to deep point
on a fullish length just outside off, and turning in. Pulled to long-on
full and wide of off, as he swats this down. Starc, at long-on, does well to run and slide to his left and take it on the bounce
fullish ball just outside off, and hinting to turn in. Punched to long-off
collapses his back knee to try and sweep, but gets this length ball outside off from the bottom of the bat towards square leg
this is faster and on a length on middle again. Nudged towards mid-on this time
half an appeal for lbw by Salt, but not given. On a fullish length on middle, and hitting his front as he looked to flick but missed

dropped by Suyash! And the ball goes on to hit the umpire just below his left knee! The umpire is in pain, as Tripathi absolutely smashed this length ball just outside off. Suyash tried to take it with both hands to his right, but the ball burst out after tickling them
this is the one turning in, as it is full and just outside off. He drives but gets it off the inside half of the bat to deep square
short of a length just outside off, and slapped to deep extra cover! The ball is crashed to beat deep point to his right, as he bags four more
this is full again, but wider outside off. He has to drag this sweep from wide outside to play to long-on
slog swept over long-on! He goes down on his back knee, and clubs this full ball finishing outside off after turning away
fullish ball dipping just outside off, and turning away. Swung to long-on
short of a length just outside off, and punched to long-on with the turn into him
short of a length outside off, and slapped to deep point

dropped by Varun at short fine leg! He seemed to have had a few minutes to keep thinking and looking at the ball, and lost it in the way. The ball hit his hands, and popped out, as Tripathi went slog sweeping off a full ball on the stumps, but got a top edge
on a length just outside off, and turning. Pulled to deep backward square's left, and the pinch two
fullish on middle and off, and turning away. Pushed to long-on
this dips on a fullish length on middle, and hints to turn in. Clipped to deep midwicket
on a length on middle and leg, and angling in. It hits his back thigh as he looked to pull but missed, and the ball rolled away towards point
well bowled! Short delivery just outside off, as Tripathi shaped to pull but then swayed out of the way, with the line being quite tight
flashed to deep point, as the ball is on a short of a length in the channel outside off
pulled to deep midwicket! Another short ball from Russell, but this on fifth stump, and Markram rides the bounce to pull comfortably

taken at fine leg! The man in the deep had to move a few steps to his left, and end at where an imaginary straightish fine leg would have been. Russell dug one a short at Abhishek, with the ball climbing nicely towards the batter's throat on middle and leg. He went for the pull, but top-edged it, with the extra pace getting the ball to zip through off the pitch
hacked just wide of deep third! On a short of a length just outside off, as Abhishek slashes at it even as he didn't have all the room to work with
uff, this turns in off a fullish length on sixth stump. He went to glide that, but was beaten
on a length on leg, and sliding down. Swept to short fine again
ahh, this turns in towards leg off a short of a length on middle and off. Swiped to deep square
shorter side of a length, and on sixth stump. Slashed to point, where the fielder tumbles to his left to stop that
fullish ball, and flatter on middle and leg. Turns away a bit, and is defended down
full and dipping on his pads. Paddle swept to short fine leg
swatted over point! He jumped down a bit while also making a bit of room, as Harshit bowled short and a bit wide outside off. There was no one out on the boundary, and Abhishek capitalised
on a length, and angled in. It pitches on off and straightens, as Abhishek goes deep in the crease to block it down
ahh, on the helmet first ball! Hits the grille, as he looks to sway away at this short-of-a-length ball rising on to middle and leg. The ball rolls away towards deep third even as it took the grille

taken at deep backward square leg! Harshit offers a stare to Agarwal, who walks back, but not without looking back at Harshit! Short delivery at sharp pace around off, as he gets good bounce. Agarwal pulls but off the higher side of the bat. The longer side of the boundary comes into play, as Rinku takes it low

ahh, this time he follows Agarwal, and bowls a good-length ball which shapes back in from off and finishes outside leg. Agarwal is cramped for room, and ends up gloving to the keeper's right in an attempt to guide it

backs away, and just clears mid-on! The fielder had turned around and started running forward, with the ball dropping over his head. Short of a length from Harshit, as Agarwal swung back down the pitch
but it doesn't make any difference! Again went across the line, with this full delivery ending around fifth stump after turning away. Slogged impactfully!
full and flat around off, and driven to long-off
goes fullish on the stumps, as Abhishek skips down again and pushes to mid-on
over wide long-on! He slog sweeps this length ball finishing around middle and off, with his back leg folding to facillitate the shot
the man at point dives across to his right, but can't get a hand. Abhishek skipped down the pitch and went lofting, but got this full ball around off from the outside half of the bat

ahh, appeal for stumping first ball! The square-leg umpire refers it up. Abhishek dragged his back leg forward but pushed it back before the bails were whipped. Varun went fullish while taking it across, as the ball finished outside off, and beating his attempted loft

pulled over mid-on, and the ball teases the fielder all the way back. Not entirely timed well - that came off the top half of the bat, as Harshit bowled a slower ball - but it was on a length and a bit wide of off, as Agarwal pulled at it
on the shorter side of a length in the corridor, and tapped to the keeper's right

superb shot! This gives me a hint as to how Kohli's straight loft off Haris would have looked had he gone over backward point. On a length just outside off from Harshit, and Agarwal simply lofted with the open face of the bat

just short of deep backward square leg running and diving forward! Ramandeep was the man there, as Agarwal walked down the pitch at this length ball wide of off, and swiped that across the line. Great effort from Ramandeep, though
ohh, he shaped to sway away at that but then ducked a bit. Harshit bowled on a length around sixth stump, with Mayank perhaps first assuming that the ball was coming his way
on a length, and slightly wide of off. He pokes it away from his body to deep third
ahh, thumped with the pace! He presents the full face of the bat at this fullish ball swinging in and finishing on leg, driving it to mid-on's right to send the ball motoring away
change of pace, as he bowls full on off at 120kph only. Pushed to mid-on for a quick single
now some extra bounce for Starc. On a length in the channel outside off, as he looks to punch without any foot movement but is beaten
full length again, but this is much straighter. Clipped to mid-on

dropped by Salt! That rubs - forgive the pun - Salt into the wounds, as the ball races away for four. Salt finished on front of first slip in trying to grab it high, but the ball popped away off his gloves. Starc bowled full and wide of off, as Abhishek went driving away from his body but got an outside edge
on a fullish length while angling across and finishing on middle and off. Dabbed late to deep third
this is shorter in length, and on a wide-ish line outside off. He looks to slap, but is beaten by the extra bounce
bowls on a length around off, and it straightens away. Nudged to midwicket
ahh, almost chopped on! He looked to slash with an angled bat, with the ball being on a length just outside off. He got a bottom edge, with the ball dribbling away past the stumps and to the leg side

loud and animated for lbw... and it is given out after probably 29 seconds! However, Agarwal reviews.
